title: Electric Delta-Kart IoT Telemetry — LilyGO T-SIM7672G V1.1
description: Single-vehicle SOTA telemetry: LilyGO T-SIM7672G V1.1 (ESP32-S3 + 4G LTE + Multi-GNSS) + Bosch BMI160 6-DOF IMU (Wire0) + DS3231 TCXO RTC & AT24C32 EEPROM (Wire1) + 18650 Battery V/mV + 32GB MicroSD Blackbox + Supabase PostgreSQL + React Three Fiber 3D Studio & Dark Leaflet Map.

items.name: Electric Delta-Kart (30mm Tube)
items.description: Single-vehicle 30mm profile tube skeleton chassis (2 steerable front wheels, 1 rear drive wheel). Instrumented with LilyGO T-SIM7672G V1.1 telemetry node.

items.name: Bosch BMI160 6-DOF IMU (0x68)
items.description: 3-axis Gyroscope (±250 °/s) + 3-axis Accelerometer (±2g) + internal die temperature (°C). Connected to Wire0 (SDA=GPIO 1, SCL=GPIO 2 @ 400kHz). Computes Roll, Pitch, Yaw, Peak G, and Vibration RMS at 30 Hz.

items.name: DS3231 TCXO RTC + AT24C32
items.description: Precision TCXO Real-Time Clock (±2ppm, 0x68) + AT24C32 32Kbit EEPROM (0x57) with CR2032 backup on dedicated Wire1 (SDA=GPIO 42, SCL=GPIO 41 @ 400kHz). Zero I2C address collision with BMI160.

items.name: 18650 Li-Ion Cell (GPIO 4 ADC)
items.description: Onboard 18650 battery holder monitored via GPIO 4 x2 hardware voltage divider. Reports strictly raw Millivolts (mV) and Volts (V) with moving-average filter (no percentage).

items.name: Solar Input Bus (GPIO 5 ADC)
items.description: 5V–6V solar charging input monitored via GPIO 5 x2 hardware voltage divider in raw mV and V.

items.name: SIM7672G Multi-GNSS Antenna
items.description: Built-in GPS + GLONASS + Galileo + BeiDou receiver with active LNA control (Modem GPIO 4). Polled every 1.5s (0.67 Hz) for Lat, Lon, Speed km/h, Altitude, Course, and atomic UTC sync to DS3231.

items.name: LilyGO T-SIM7672G V1.1 (ESP32-S3)
items.description: Master MCU: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 MCN16R8 (Dual-Core 240MHz, 16MB Flash, 8MB OPI PSRAM) + onboard SIM7672G 4G LTE Cat-1 & Multi-GNSS modem.

items.name: 32GB MicroSD Blackbox (5Hz CSV)
items.description: Onboard SPI MicroSD slot (CS:13, MOSI:14, SCK:21, MISO:47). Logs full-rate CSV telemetry every 200ms (5 Hz) to /logs/kart_session_XXXX.csv (>11,000 hours capacity).

items.name: Parametric BIST Self-Test
items.description: Boot & live self-test engine verifying Wi-Fi, 4G LTE SIM, BMI160 (0x68), 18650 Battery (>=2500mV), DS3231 RTC (0x68), and 32GB MicroSD mount. Syncs JSON report to kart_sessions.test.

items.name: Local Wi-Fi WebSocket (30Hz)
items.description: Low-latency 30 Hz (every 33ms) JSON telemetry stream on port 81/8081 over LAN or fallback AP (Kart-IMU-AP) with 0 MB SIM data cost.

items.name: 4G LTE Cat-1 (Movistar 220MB)
items.description: SIM7672G cellular data link (APN: internet.movistar.com.co). Adaptive cloud sync: every 3s (0.33 Hz) when moving, every 60s when parked (>650 hours active driving on 220 MB plan).

items.name: Supabase PostgreSQL DB
items.description: Cloud database storing kart_sessions and ultra-compact kart_telemetry (~76 bytes/row using SMALLINT/REAL/DOUBLE PRECISION + BRIN time-series index) and v_kart_live view.

items.name: 500MB Free-Tier Ring-Buffer
items.description: PostgreSQL trigger enforce_telemetry_storage_cap() automatically prunes oldest 50,000 rows if kart_telemetry exceeds 2,500,000 rows (~220 MB), guaranteeing <500 MB free tier forever.

items.name: Supabase Realtime Stream
items.description: PostgreSQL replication publication (supabase_realtime) pushing live kart_telemetry inserts & REST queries to remote web clients.

items.name: R3F 3D Kart Studio (View 1)
items.description: React Three Fiber interactive 3D chassis studio rendering the parametric 30mm tube skeleton Delta-Kart with real-time Roll, Pitch, Yaw, steering angle, and Peak G.

items.name: Dark Leaflet + 3D Kart Overlay
items.description: Dark-mode OpenStreetMap Leaflet GPS trajectory with a transparent R3F 3D Delta-Kart canvas overlaid directly on the live GPS coordinate + View 3 Chase Cam PIP.

items.name: Day Replay & G-G Charts (View 2)
items.description: Multi-channel historical analytics, G-G traction circle, 18650 battery discharge curve (mV), dual thermal profile (BMI160 vs DS3231), and MicroSD CSV replay scrubber.
